title: Plan a marketing campaign
text: Help me plan a marketing campaign for [business]. My audience is [audience], my goal is [goal], and my budget is [budget]. Suggest practical actions, a timeline, and ways to measure results. Clearly label any assumptions.

title: Improve a website page
text: Review this page text: [paste text]. The audience is [audience]. Suggest a clearer title, useful headings, and a short description. Do not invent facts, customer reviews, or performance claims.

title: Write a customer follow-up
text: Write a friendly follow-up message for a customer who asked about [service]. Include [helpful detail] and one simple next step. Keep it clear and avoid pressure or promises.

title: Find tasks to automate
text: My team spends time on [tasks]. Help me identify which tasks may be suitable for automation, what data and permissions are needed, where human review is important, and how to test a small pilot.
